cs336_rope_model.title: Numeric RoPE model (rotate, rotaryPair, rotatePairs)
cs336_rope_model.note: rotaryPair() drives the shared-shift fixture (q=[1,0], k=[0.7,0.7], theta=pi/6); rotatePairs() applies block-diagonal rotation with theta_j = base^(-2j/d), j from 0.
